welcomeDescription.message: Thanks for installing Mouse Gesture! Hold the right button and drag for navigation, tabs, and scrolling; hold right or left with the wheel (and more combos in settings) for extra shortcuts—recognition stays forgiving, including while pages load. Super Drag opens links, images, files, and text searches with separate rules for eight directions (foreground, background, split layout, copy to clipboard, and more). Popup View shows link previews or searches selected text in small windows. You also get optional screenshots (visible area, full page, scroll stitching, history, and preview), image hover preview (with an enhanced mode), duplicate-tab detection with optional auto-close, smooth scrolling, a toolbar tab-count badge, and optional page unlock for sites that block copy or right-click. Open settings from the toolbar as a popup, in the browser side panel when available, or in a detached window; export or import your options; settings sync with your browser account. 29 languages and light/dark themes.

welcomeCoreGestureBlock.message: Mouse gestures: Hold right and drag for path gestures; also hold-right wheel, hold-left wheel, and hold-right with left/right click—all remappable in settings to many actions; stroke matching is forgiving and still works while pages load.
welcomeCoreGestureBlock.description: Welcome page: core features gesture summary

welcomeCoreSuperDragBlock.message: Super Drag: Drag links, images, and files; drag selected text to search. Each of the eight directions can open foreground, background, split layout (four sides), copy to clipboard, and more; optional auto-download when dragging images/files; default and per-direction search URLs.
welcomeCoreSuperDragBlock.description: Welcome page: core features super drag summary

welcomeCorePopupViewBlock.message: Popup View: Hold the trigger key (default Shift) while hovering a link to preview the target in a small window; after selecting text, press the trigger key to search instantly in a popup with your custom search engine.
welcomeCorePopupViewBlock.description: Welcome page: core features popup view summary
